integrity: Complete self-contained analytic proof with a supplementary reproducible finite checker. No claim of independent validation, priority, or certification.
limitations: Classifies saturation of the two-ball factor and its exact cutoff on the clipped-disk and even regular-polygon families, not its numerical value below the universal ceiling or a new planar covering constant. Only symmetric finite-dimensional norms are treated.
title: Exposed-face saturation of the two-ball dilation constant
